title: Visitor bays marked and signposted, on common property and connected to building entries, Perth and Peel
text: C2.3.4 Visitor car parking spaces to be: i. marked and clearly signposted as dedicated for visitor use only; ii. located on common property; and iii. connected to building entries via a continuous path of travel.

replaces.note: 'outside any security barrier' and 'close to or visible from the entry' dropped

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: Chapter 2 C2.3.4 is the regional AS2890.1 clause (its Chapter 3 twin is C2.3.6); this clause is the visitor bay specification, which has no Chapter 2 equivalent. One applicant fact answers (i) to (iii) (see FACTS-PROPOSED-part2.md). Applies wherever visitor bays are provided. Twin of C2.3.8 (outside Perth and Peel).
